d: With Grayson reincarnated as a death row inmate, Jane must stop his execution. Kim represents a choreographer whose work was stolen by a pop star. Owen suffers from panic attacks, jeopardizing his wedding to Stacy.
As Jane seeks to ban a dietary supplement that killed a teenage football player, Kim fights to save the job of a bailiff who stopped her from being mugged while dressed as a superhero.

In the series finale, Jane has left the firm and faces Owen in a lawsuit against an anti-whaling group. As Stacy tries to salvage her wedding plans, Ian discovers that Teri and he share a tumultuous past.
A fatal car accident sends the soul of a beautiful but vapid model into the body of a brilliant plus-size attorney.
A plus-sized cocktail waitress' workplace discrimination lawsuit helps Jane come to terms with her new body.

While retrying a lawsuit against a company whose work rules caused an employee's death, Jane's emotional outburst lands her in jail  Grayson and Kim sue a psychiatrist who claims to cure multiple personality disorder.
As she and Kim represent a client who is unhappy with the dog he paid to have cloned from his late prize-winning golden retriever, Jane and Grayson land on opposing sides in Deb's parents' divorce.
While Jane's job is in jeopardy after she costs a wrongfully imprisoned man the settlement he's offered, Grayson finds it difficult to represent a client charged with helping break up a marriage.
